latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Align default development catalog (Library records) permissions with production by @CipherZ3r0 in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14238
* Replace deprecated datetime.utcnow() and utcfromtimestamp() (ruff DTZ003, DTZ004) by @gauranshahuja in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14243
* fix: bound language caches and clean up FastAPI worker state by @dhruvwarriorr in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14006
* fix: recover legacy database connections after disconnects by @dhruvwarriorr in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14153
* feat(marc): import 520 $b and $c, and label notes by first indicator by @pillarsdotnet in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14050
* Load the donation banner script async so it doesn't block rendering by @Animesh-Jantwal in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14288
* Migrate ol-covers0 → ol-covers1 by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14294
* fix(fastapi): cap limit at 100 on /search/inside.json by @ravithemore in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14307
* Polish Tasks: tasks left on the initiative card, a roomier cover form, and a saved card by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14258
* Use GitHub issue types in bug/feature issue templates by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14312
* Add a genre task and multiple initiatives to Tasks by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14278
* Count every Tasks community project on /stats/tasks by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14301
* Point editors to Tasks from the thank-you banner after a save by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14303
* Update on-call configuration by @jimchamp in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/13726
* Escape backslashes in job summary table cells by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14329
* Remove Needs: Response when a flagged lead or the issue's lead replies by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14330
* Swap Needs: Response for Needs: Review when a PR references an issue by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14331
* Update eslint to v10.14.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14082
* Update actions/setup-python action to v7.1.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14246
* Update astral-sh/setup-uv action to v10.3.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14320
* chore(renovate): reduce PR volume (group Actions, monthly schedule) by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14332
* chore(renovate): group leftover npm deps into one PR by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14333
* chore(renovate): bump npm ranges in package.json, not just the lockfile by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14335
* chore(renovate): group Python deps into test & lint, scripts, web stack and other by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14336
* ci: run bundlesize as its own job by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14337
* Update JS build deps by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14334
* chore(renovate): keep pre-commit hook versions in sync with requirements and package.json by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14340
* Update Python test & lint deps by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14338
* Fix the Tasks 'Just saved' card showing a genre for a fiction/nonfiction answer by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14325
